description: Turn cold, hot, and target hot pressures into the next cold pressure to try. Calculates from measured inputs without authentication and does not read or save account data. This gives a next-test pressure, not a universal ideal. Recheck after the next run.

ambientChange.description: Expected ambient temp change (F in imperial; C in metric)

cold.description: Starting cold pressure (psi in imperial; bar in metric)

hot.description: Measured hot pressure (psi in imperial; bar in metric)

target.description: Target hot pressure (psi in imperial; bar in metric)

unitSystem.description: Units for all inputs and results, as specified on each field.

name: calculate_tire_pressure_adjustment

outputSchema.description: Public calculator result with explicit units, website-equivalent results, or actionable invalid_input message.

outcome.description: Optional domain outcome for an otherwise successful read.

status.description: Stable result status such as ok, created, updated, sent, auth_required, or confirmation_required.

tool.description: TuneWorks MCP tool name that produced this result.

websiteHandoff.description: Required website destination for a workflow intentionally kept outside MCP.
